2) Or I can reissue the GCal invite from my personal account instead of the shared calendar which usually preserves the Join button when recipients accept.

Which do you prefer? If Zoom works, I'll generate the link and push an updated invite and an ICS with the Zoom join URL.

Action plan if you want Zoom: I will create Zoom link, send new invite from ben.carter@redwood.com, cc your it-admin, and include the ICS (redwood-demo-zoom.ics).

Happy to do whichever is lowest friction for your ops team — ping me and I'll act.

Best,
